LanguageData.TMM.Event.Common.ItemMissing: Required item is no longer available on the map.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.Common.ColonistUnavailable: The selected colonist is no longer available.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.BosTechDemand.Title: Brotherhood tech requisition
LanguageData.TMM.Event.BosTechDemand.Text: A power-armored patrol from {0} has hailed the settlement. Their scribe has detected a restricted piece of technology ({1}) and demands you surrender it for safekeeping under the Codex.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.BosTechDemand.AcceptMsg: {0} accepted the requisitioned technology with approval.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.BosTechDemand.RefuseMsg: {0} logged your defiance as technology hoarding.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.BosPaladinShelter.Title: Paladin requests shelter
LanguageData.TMM.Event.BosPaladinShelter.Text: A battered field paladin from {0} asks for two days of safe shelter to recharge power cells and patch armor plating. They promise medical supplies and goodwill in return.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.BosPaladinShelter.AcceptMsg: Paladin {0} is entering the settlement to rest for two days.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.BosPaladinShelter.DoneText: {0} thanks the colony for the hospitality, leaving behind a drop of industrial medicine before marching out. Ad Victoriam.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.OutcastsTechForMeds.Title: Outcasts salvage exchange
LanguageData.TMM.Event.OutcastsTechForMeds.Text: A scavenger team from {0} offers 10 industrial medicine in exchange for your {1}. No sermons, strictly hardware for supplies.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.OutcastsTechForMeds.AcceptMsg: The Outcasts delivered 10 industrial medicine in exchange for your technology.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.OutcastsCaravanAmbush.Title: Outcasts roadblock
LanguageData.TMM.Event.OutcastsCaravanAmbush.Text: An armored squad from {0} has boxed in your caravan near their patrol sector. They demand a {1} silver salvage toll to let you pass unharmed.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.OutcastsCaravanAmbush.PaidMsg: Your caravan paid {0} silver and passed the Outcasts roadblock safely.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.EnclavePropaganda.Title: Enclave radio broadcast
LanguageData.TMM.Event.EnclavePunitiveDrop.Title: Enclave punitive strike
LanguageData.TMM.Event.EnclavePunitiveDrop.Text: Enclave command has designated your settlement a hostile insurgent cell. {0} strike troopers are dropping directly onto your perimeter!
LanguageData.TMM.Event.InstituteCourserAbduction.Text: Blue relay flashes split the air! A compact retrieval team from {0} has teleported in to abduct one of your colonists.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.InstituteSynthReplacement.Text: Short-range telemetry spikes briefly flickered near the barracks — classic signature of a {0} molecular relay. Everyone is accounted for, yet someone feels subtly... different.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.InstituteSynthReplacement.Reve: Routine medical scans have uncovered an Institute synth component inside {0}. They were quietly replaced weeks ago — though for now they remain loyal to the settlement.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.RailroadFugitiveSynth.Title: Fugitive synth seeks sanctuary
LanguageData.TMM.Event.RailroadFugitiveSynth.Text: A courier from {0} brings word of a newly liberated synth hiding nearby. They can join your colony immediately, but Institute hunters will track them here within three days.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.RailroadFugitiveSynth.Accept: Grant sanctuary (joins colony; Institute pursuit in 3 days)
LanguageData.TMM.Event.RailroadFugitiveSynth.AcceptMs: {0} has joined the colony under Railroad protection. Expect Institute pursuit in 3 days.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.RailroadDeadDrop.Title: Railroad dead-drop cache
LanguageData.TMM.Event.RailroadDeadDrop.Text: A scout spotted a chalk lantern rail-sign etched on a boulder nearby. Beneath it lies a hidden {0} supply cache stocked with silver, medicine, and components.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GunnersExtortion.Title: Gunners protection demand
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GunnersExtortion.Text: A platoon leader from {0} radios from the ridge: pay a {1} silver "security fee" now, or their squads move in and collect it in lead.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GunnersExtortion.PaidMsg: Paid {0} silver to the Gunners. Their squad pulls back from the ridge.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GunnersMercContract.Title: Gunners mercenary contract
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GunnersMercContract.Text: Two off-duty veterans from {0} offer to serve your colony for one full season (15 days) for an upfront retainer of {1} silver.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GunnersMercContract.HiredMsg: {0} Gunner mercenaries have entered the colony on a 15-day contract.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GunnersMercContract.ExpiredMsg: The Gunner mercenary contract has expired; the hired fighters are departing.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.VaultTecExperiment.Title: Vault-Tec "voluntary" clinical trial
LanguageData.TMM.Event.VaultTecExperiment.Text: A cheerful representative from {0} invites {1} to participate in an experimental vitality serum study. Completely voluntary, totally safe (probably), and pays a crisp silver stipend.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.VaultTecExperiment.Accept: Participate in trial (+{0} silver, experimental serum)
LanguageData.TMM.Event.VaultTecExperiment.AcceptMsg: {0} received the Vault-Tec trial serum and the promised stipend.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.VaultTecSupplyCaravan.Title: Vault-Tec surplus drop
LanguageData.TMM.Event.VaultTecSupplyCaravan.Text: A logistics officer from {0} offers a subsidized pre-war Vault surplus pallet (16 survival meals, 8 medicine, 6 components) for {1} silver.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.VaultTecSupplyCaravan.BoughtMs: Vault-Tec surplus supplies have landed near your settlement.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MinutemenDistressSignal.Title: Minutemen distress call
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MinutemenDistressSignal.Text: Radio Freedom crackles to life! {0} reports a nearby outpost under siege by raiders and asks if you can mark the coordinates on your world map and send help.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MinutemenDistressSignal.Accept: Mark distress site on world map (+8 goodwill)
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MinutemenDistressSignal.SiteCr: Distress signal coordinates marked on the world map.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HuntersMonsterWarning.Title: Hunter warning: monsters inbound
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HuntersMonsterWarning.Text: A traveling hunter allied with {0} stopped by to warn you: a hunting pack from {1} has picked up your scent and will strike in roughly two days. Prepare silver and salt.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MolBuyRecords.Title: Men of Letters lore acquisition
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MolBuyRecords.TextArchive: An emissary from {0} has learned you possess {1}. They offer {2} silver and strong diplomatic favor to acquire it for their London vault.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MolBuyRecords.TextNotes: An archivist from {0} requests copies of your settlement's field observations on supernatural monsters, offering {1} silver for the dossier.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MolBuyRecords.SellNotes: Share field notes for {0} silver (+8 goodwill)
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MolBuyRecords.SoldMsg: The Men of Letters wired {0} silver for your supernatural records.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MolRecruitment.Title: Men of Letters recruitment offer
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MolRecruitment.Text: {0} has taken note of {1}'s sharp intellect and offers to recruit them into their chapter in exchange for a {2} silver stipend, 2 advanced components, and major goodwill.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MolRecruitment.Accept: Release {0} to the Chapter (+{1} silver, +2 adv. components)
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MolRecruitment.AcceptMsg: {0} has departed to join {1}. Your stipend has arrived.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HeavenVesselRequest.Title: Angel seeks a willing vessel
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HeavenVesselRequest.Text: A resonant voice from {0} speaks to {1}, asking permission to briefly share their vessel to stabilize a rift. Saying yes bestows lasting angelic grace and Heaven's favor.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HeavenDivineOmen.Title: Celestial omen
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HellCrossroadsDeal.Title: Crossroads bargain
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HellCrossroadsDeal.Text: A sharp-dressed dealmaker from {0} waits at the crossroads with an irresistible offer: {1} silver and 4 glitterworld medicine right now — in exchange for a "collection visit" exactly one year from today.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HellCrossroadsDeal.Accept: Seal the deal (+{0} silver, +4 glitterworld meds; debt in 1 year)
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HellCrossroadsDeal.AcceptMsg: The crossroads contract is signed. Expect Hell's collectors in one year.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HellCrossroadsDeal.DueText: One year has passed since the crossroads bargain signed in {0}'s name. Hellhounds and demons have arrived to collect!
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HellDemonicPossession.Title: Demonic possession
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HellDemonicPossession.Text: Black smoke coils around {0} as a rogue spirit from {1} forces its way into their body! You can spend {2} silver on emergency exorcism supplies to banish it, or let {0} endure the possession for several days.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HellDemonicPossession.Exorcise: The demon was cast out of {0} in a burst of sulfur smoke.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.HellDemonicPossession.Possesse: {0}'s eyes flash pitch black as the demon takes hold.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GhoulsRefugees.Title: Ghoul refugees seek shelter
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GhoulsRefugees.Text: Two sane ghoul wanderers affiliated with {0} were driven out of a nearby town by bigots and ask to settle with your colony permanently.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GhoulsRefugees.AcceptMsg: {0} ghoul refugees have joined the colony.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GhoulsRadTrade.Title: Radioactive salvage offer
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GhoulsRadTrade.Text: Scavengers from {0} hauled 45 uranium and 120 chemfuel out of a hot crater no smoothskin could enter. They will sell the whole lot for {1} silver.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.GhoulsRadTrade.BoughtMsg: The ghoul scavengers delivered uranium and chemfuel to your drop zone.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.FriendlyMutantJoin.Title: Wandering super mutant
LanguageData.TMM.Event.FriendlyMutantJoin.Text: A thoughtful, peaceful super mutant from {0} has arrived at your borders seeking a home where they can work and protect gentle humans.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.FriendlyMutantHeal.Title: Wounded mutant kinsman
LanguageData.TMM.Event.FriendlyMutantHeal.Text: {0} asks if your medics can tend a wounded brother who survived a raider ambush. Patch them up over the next two days for steel and lasting gratitude.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.FriendlyMutantHeal.Accept: Agree to tend the wounded mutant
LanguageData.TMM.Event.FriendlyMutantHeal.AcceptMsg: Wounded super mutant {0} is entering the settlement for medical care.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.FriendlyMutantHeal.DoneText: {0} is back on their feet thanks to your doctors and leaves 120 salvaged steel as a thank-you gift.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.WildMutantsMeatBags.Title: Mutant raid with captives!
LanguageData.TMM.Event.WildMutantsMeatBags.Text: A warband from {0} is charging the settlement — and they dragged two bound human captives ("meat bags") to the edge of the map! Drive off the mutants to rescue the prisoners.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.WildMutantsWarlordDuel.Title: Mutant warlord challenge
LanguageData.TMM.Event.WildMutantsWarlordDuel.Text: A towering warlord from {0} bellows at your gates, demanding single combat! Face the lone champion for their 500-silver trophy pouch, or refuse and face the whole warband.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.WildMutantsWarlordDuel.Accept: Accept the warlord's challenge (1 champion, 500 silver loot)
LanguageData.TMM.Event.WildMutantsWarlordDuel.AcceptM: Warlord {0} strides onto the field for single combat!
LanguageData.TMM.Event.WildMutantsWarlordDuel.Refuse: Refuse — brace for a full raid!
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MonsterVampireNightHunt.Title: Vampire night hunt
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MonsterVampireNightHunt.Text: Under the cover of darkness, a hunting nest from {0} has slipped across your borders to feed!
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MonsterShapeshifterGuest.Title: Werewolf among guests!
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MonsterShapeshifterGuest.Text: A traveler named {0} just wandered into your settlement, but your sharpest lookout caught silver-allergy burns on their wrist and yellow reflections in their eyes. Confront them now, or ignore the warning at your peril.
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MonsterShapeshifterGuest.Confr: Cornered, {0} drops their disguise and lunges at the colony!
LanguageData.TMM.Event.MonsterShapeshifterGuest.Trans: The lookout was right! {0} has dropped all pretense and attacked the colony from within!
LanguageData.TMM.Event.Common.PaymentFailed: The exchange could not be completed. Payment was kept and you can try again.
